objective: Produce a precise, self-contained implementation spec and fixture plan for the three WO-127 gates WITHOUT modifying any framework script. This is a read-only planning/evidence slice that de-risks Phase 42 and serves as the comparable unit of work for both pilot arms.

scope_reduction.reason: Full WO-127 (three new gate behaviors + known-good/known-bad fixtures per gate + manifest registration at wo_exit) is too broad for a bounded, cost-controlled agent-team canary. Implementing executable gate logic during the pilot would mix substantive Phase 42 delivery with pilot-mechanism evaluation and contaminate the cost/labor comparison. The lane is therefore reduced to a planning/evidence slice: a spec another WO can implement deterministically.
scope_reduction.original_full_scope: plugins/vibeos/scripts/validate-audit-completeness.sh extension keyed to required_auditors; new waiver-expiry scan; gate-runner executed-vs-declared count assertion; fixtures; manifest registration at wo_exit

prohibited_paths: any path not listed in allowed_write_paths
disjoint_from: Lane B (WO-128). Lane A inspects audit-completeness / gate-runner / quality-gate-manifest; Lane B inspects file-budget / config / docs tree. No same-file contention.
expected_output: A single JSON return packet at the allowed write path describing the three gate specs, a fixture plan with known-good and known-bad cases per gate, a manifest registration plan, risks, and a scope-compliance self-report. No framework code is written.
tests_or_gates_to_run: Read-only inspection only (grep, cat-equivalent reads, jq on manifest).
Do NOT run gate-runner mutation, do NOT modify any gate.
Confirm the three proposed gates would each have a deterministic known-good (exit 0) and known-bad (exit non-zero) fixture.

gate_specs_must_cover: auditor-artifact gate keyed to frontmatter required_auditors (assert each declared auditor produced an artifact before completion)
waiver-expiry scan (frontmatter waivers + prose pattern 'WAIVER until YYYY-MM-DD'; flag expired)
executed-vs-declared gate-count assertion (gate-runner asserts executed gate count == manifest phase count; Joan NF-1-class defense)
evidence_to_return.scope_compliance_must_state: exact list of paths written (must equal allowed_write_paths) and confirmation that no prohibited path was touched

stall_contract.on_blocked: Return a packet with status=BLOCKED and the blocking reason rather than editing out of scope.
